# Rear air tank mounting for On Board Air systems

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Mount the CO2 or compressed air tank on either side in the back of the truck. [t440]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Mount the CO2 or compressed air tank on either side in the back of the truck.
2. [Partial] Cut the carpet and drill holes in the floor to secure the mounting area.
3. [Partial] File, spray paint, and run bolts through the drilled holes for a clean look.
4. Lay the carpet back over the bottom of the holder to dampen metal-on-metal vibrations.
5. Locate a strip of sheet metal under the plastic molding just above the pocket and below the speaker.
6. Drill two lining-up holes through both the sheet metal and the plastic molding.
7. Run long bolts (approx 6") with lock nuts on one side to secure the bracket to the sheet metal.
8. Place the plastic molding back over the protruding bolts and add another lock nut.

_Procedure reported by [t440]._
